answer: The change belongs in `AlterTogetherOptionOperation` in django/django/db/migrations/operations/models.py. It is the shared base class of `AlterUniqueTogether` and `AlterIndexTogether`. The optimization is a `reduce()` method on this class, so that consecutive AlterFooTogether operations on the same model collapse into the last one. This class has no `reduce()` yet (I read lines 468–537 and found none), so that is where the change goes. I did not look for the fix elsewhere in the repo.

The fix is in `TestCase.captureOnCommitCallbacks()` in django/django/test/testcases.py. The `while True` loop in its `finally` block handles recursive capture. It re-reads `run_on_commit` after callbacks run. If new callbacks were registered, it moves `start_count` and loops again. The loop spans lines 1259-1269. The regression test is `test_execute_recursive` in tests/test_utils/tests.py:1787.

LocaleMiddleware.process_request in django/middleware/locale.py. It calls get_language_from_request with check_path=i18n_patterns_used. It falls back to settings.LANGUAGE_CODE only when the path has no language prefix and the default language isn't prefixed.

The --debug-sql behaviour is implemented by `DebugSQLTextTestResult` in django/django/test/runner.py. `startTest` creates the `logging.StreamHandler` that captures the `django.db.backends` SQL log output, and that handler is where the formatting would go. This checkout doesn't yet format the SQL: `runner.py` doesn't use `sqlparse`, and the handler has no formatter. I'm citing line 52 because that is where the formatting change would go.
